title: Luxuriant Creamy Tunisian Mung Bean Sprouts Tagine
description: A rich and creamy one-pot dish featuring mung bean sprouts, tandoor spices, and ayurvedic-tamasic-friendly ingredients, with a bitter and creamy flavor profile, this Tunisian tagine is a unique and delicious meal option.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large clay or ceramic tagine or Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the tandoor spice blend and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the mung bean sprouts and cook until they are tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the coconut cream and vegetable broth, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook until the sauce has thickened and the flavors have melded together, about 10 minutes.
Season the tagine with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with fresh herbs or spices if desired.
